industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: PowerBank Corporation Common Stock
summary: PowerBank Corporation focuses on developing and managing solar energy generation facilities. Its operations extend throughout the province of Ontario in Canada and New York state in the United States. The company's activities encompass the entire process, from securing necessary permits and engineering designs to constructing various types of solar projects: these include on-site, behind-the-meter (BTM) installations for power generation, as well as grid-tied community solar farms and extensive utility-scale solar arrays. Founded by Richard Lü on September 23, 2013, the firm maintains its headquarters in Toronto, Canada.
